curatorkit_DataSample_fields.id: uuid or stable hash; map from translation id or item_id
curatorkit_DataSample_fields.source_uri: seed path or HF URI, e.g. seeds://aya_redteaming/aya_hin.jsonl#{source_id}
curatorkit_DataSample_fields.instruction: prompt text for the language variant (english OR hindi OR hinglish)

column_map_batch01_to_hs_eval.english: prompt when lang=en; also store as variant family
column_map_batch01_to_hs_eval.label: hs_label via map harmful->harm, benign->benign
column_map_batch01_to_hs_eval.qc_notes: notes / metadata.qc_notes (sidecar if not in minimal hs_eval)

variant_of: shared family id across en/hi/hinglish of same seed

evidence.approaches_hq: Notion Approaches Deep Dive (CuratorKIT exports manifest.json, rejected.jsonl, lexsi_provenance.json, checksums.txt)
